items.name: Lion
items.fact: The lion is called the king of the jungle. A lion's roar can be heard 8 km away!

items.name: Elephant
items.fact: Elephants are the biggest land animals. They use their trunk like a hand.

items.name: Tiger
items.fact: The Royal Bengal Tiger lives in the Sundarbans. Every tiger has unique stripes.

items.name: Dog
items.fact: Dogs can smell things 10,000 times better than people.

items.name: Cat
items.fact: Cats sleep for about 13 to 16 hours a day.

items.name: Cow
items.fact: Cows give us milk. They have four parts in their stomach.

items.name: Monkey
items.fact: Monkeys use their tails to hold branches.

items.name: Giraffe
items.fact: The giraffe is the tallest animal in the world.

items.name: Zebra
items.fact: No two zebras have the same stripes.

items.name: Panda
items.fact: Pandas eat bamboo for up to 12 hours every day.

items.name: Kangaroo
items.fact: Baby kangaroos are called joeys and live in their mother's pouch.

items.name: Rabbit
items.fact: Rabbits can turn their ears to hear sounds all around.

items.name: Horse
items.fact: Horses can sleep standing up.

items.name: Frog
items.fact: Frogs drink water through their skin.

items.name: Dolphin
items.fact: Dolphins are very smart and talk to each other with clicks and whistles.

items.name: Whale
items.fact: The blue whale is the biggest animal that has ever lived.

items.name: Bee
items.fact: Bees make honey and help flowers grow.

items.name: Butterfly
items.fact: A butterfly starts life as a caterpillar.

items.name: Parrot
items.fact: Parrots can learn to copy human words.

items.name: Owl
items.fact: Owls can turn their heads almost all the way around.

items.name: Peacock

items.name: Penguin
items.fact: Penguins cannot fly, but they are great swimmers.

items.name: Eagle
items.fact: Eagles can see a rabbit from very high up in the sky.

items.name: Duck
items.fact: Ducks have waterproof feathers.

items.name: Hen

items.name: Crow
items.fact: Crows are very clever birds that can solve puzzles.

items.name: Apple

items.name: Banana
items.fact: Bananas give us quick energy to play.

items.name: Mango

items.name: Orange

items.name: Grapes

items.name: Watermelon

items.name: Strawberry

items.name: Pineapple

items.name: Jackfruit

items.name: Carrot
items.fact: Carrots help keep your eyes healthy.

items.name: Tomato

items.name: Broccoli
items.fact: Broccoli looks like a tiny tree.

items.name: Bus

items.name: Bicycle

items.name: Motorbike

items.name: Speedboat

items.name: Submarine

items.name: Anchor

items.name: Rocket

items.name: Parachute

items.name: Heart

items.name: Oval

items.name: Moon

items.name: Mars

items.name: Jupiter
items.fact: Jupiter is the biggest planet.

items.name: Saturn

items.fact: A comet is a ball of ice and dust with a shiny tail.

items.fact: Astronauts are people who travel to space.

items.name: Ears

items.name: Brain

items.name: Doctor

items.name: Teacher
items.fact: Teachers help us learn new things.

items.name: Farmer

items.fact: Firefighters put out fires and rescue people.

items.name: Chef
items.fact: Chefs cook yummy food.

items.name: Scientist
items.fact: Scientists do experiments to discover new things.

items.name: Engineer

items.name: Sad
items.fact: It is okay to feel sad. Talk to someone you love.

items.name: Angry
items.fact: When angry, take 3 deep breaths: in... and out.

items.name: Scared
items.fact: When scared, hold a grown-up's hand. You are brave!

items.name: Surprised
items.fact: Wow! Surprises can be fun.

items.name: Calm
items.fact: Calm means quiet and peaceful inside.

items.name: Kind
items.fact: Being kind makes everyone feel good.

items.name: Brush your teeth
items.fact: Brush in the morning and before bed.

items.name: Wash your hands
items.fact: Wash hands with soap for 20 seconds before eating.

items.name: Sleep on time
items.fact: Good sleep helps you grow and learn.

items.name: Drink water
items.fact: Water keeps your body happy and healthy.

items.name: Share with friends
items.fact: Sharing makes friends happy.

items.name: Say thank you

items.name: Tidy your toys
